#!/usr/bin/env node
/* Split a TriangleEdge rebuild archive back into the file tree.
   Usage:  node split-rebuild.mjs <rebuild.txt> [outDir]
   Works on the single archive OR the concatenation of all parts
   (cat part1 part2 part3 part4 > all.txt). */
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

const input = process.argv[2];
const outDir = process.argv[3] ?? ".";
if (!input) {
  console.error("Usage: node split-rebuild.mjs <rebuild.txt> [outDir]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const text = readFileSync(input, "utf8");
const lines = text.split("\n");
let cur = null;
let buf = [];
let written = 0;
const flush = () => {
  if (!cur) return;
  let content = buf.join("\n");
  if (cur.nl) content += "\n";
  const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(content, "utf8");
  if (bytes !== cur.bytes) console.warn("byte mismatch (expected " + cur.bytes + ", got " + bytes + "): " + cur.path);
  const dest = join(outDir, cur.path);
  mkdirSync(dirname(dest), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(dest, content);
  written++;
  console.log("restored " + cur.path);
};
for (const line of lines) {
  const m = line.match(/^@@TE_FILE@@ path=(\S+) bytes=(\d+) nl=(0|1)/);
  if (m) {
    flush();
    cur = { path: m[1], bytes: Number(m[2]), nl: m[3] === "1" };
    buf = [];
    continue;
  }
  if (cur) {
    if (/^@@TE_(END|REBUILD|REBUILD_PART)@@/.test(line)) {
      flush();
      cur = null;
    } else buf.push(line);
  }
}
flush();
console.log(written + " files restored into " + outDir);

# TriangleEdge — build lock (LOCK.md)

> Generated: 2026 · Hero v2 — Neural Trade Flow (particles + rotating globe)
> This is the checked-in baseline. Regenerate after each successful build via
> Theme Studio → WordPress → "Regenerate lock files" to refresh fingerprints.

## Hero v2 contract (do not regress)

- `TIERS[0]` must be `1` — a zero here spawns 0 particles (the v1 bug).
- Particles are the persistent neural network (cosmic → orbit shell around the
  globe → triangle convergence). The globe is a separate wireframe render —
  particles never "become" continents.
- Connections: max 8 per particle, 0.3–1.2px, additive pulses travel along them.
- Palette-reactive: canvas reads CSS vars each palette-gen bump (hex/rgb/hsl).
- Loop is try/catch-guarded and self-heals if N < 50.

This file, together with `lock.json`, is the server-reset protection baseline.
Keep both at the project root so the build can be replicated byte-for-byte
after any workspace reset.

## Rebuild from zero

```bash
npm install        # dependencies are pinned in lock.json
npm run dev        # preview
npm run build      # production bundle (Vite)
```

## Stack & pinned dependencies

- React 18.2.0 · ReactDOM 18.2.0 · TypeScript 5.7.0
- Vite 6.3.5 · @vitejs/plugin-react 4.3.4
- Tailwind CSS 4.1.7 · @tailwindcss/vite 4.1.7
- jszip ^3.10.1 (lazy-loaded, export only)

## Documented pitfalls

1. Hero canvas must size from the 100vh sticky viewport, not the 300vh scroll track.
2. Copy-override reactivity requires bumping a rev counter (useCopyRev) — a plain module var won't re-render.
3. applyColors must never wipe the gold-family vars (owned by applyAccent).
4. Downloads in the sandboxed preview can be blocked — always offer a real clickable anchor as fallback.
5. The workspace resets between sessions — keep LOCK.md + lock.json + the source archive zip as the recovery path.
6. `translate.ts` merge/diff must tolerate unknown/malformed types (never throw).
7. Saved payloads use versioned keys (v5); stale v1–v4 data is abandoned, and normalize() repairs every field.
8. Hero particles: crisp cores only — a large `arc(pr*3)` halo layer reads as unwanted rings. Glow belongs to bright front nodes only, ≤ ~2× core radius, low alpha.
9. Globe look = dark sphere body (drawn BEFORE the network) + glowing surface node-network + trade arcs. NOT a lat/lon wireframe grid, and the dark body must never be painted over the near-side network.
10. `TIERS[0]` must be 1 — a 0 there silently spawns zero particles.
11. City-infrastructure web + signal rings are inserted INSIDE drawFrame AFTER the particle for-loop closes. When editing that region, keep the particle-loop `}` + `source-over` reset intact or the whole file desyncs.
12. The transport parade was rolled back and archived as **"The Freight Ballet"** — see `archive/freight-ballet/README.md`. The module is dormant at `src/parade.ts` (runtime never imports it) and ships in every rebuild-paste/source archive under `archive/freight-ballet/parade.ts`. Its `ThemeSettings` keys (`paradeShips/Planes/Trucks/Train/Speed/Wake`) remain dormant for future re-enablement. Do not re-integrate without the user asking.

## Sync protocol (after EVERY build/revision)

1. Regenerate lock files — Theme Studio → WordPress → "Regenerate lock files"
   (re-hashes all sources with SHA-256 via WebCrypto).
2. Replace the root `lock.json` + `LOCK.md` with the regenerated copies so the
   baseline moves forward.
3. Re-sync `snapshot/` mirrors (package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.js,
   index.html) if any root config changed.
4. Confirm `lock.json embeddedConfigs` is byte-identical to the root configs.
5. Re-export the source archive so `src/**` + BUILD_LOCK.md stay current.
6. Run the 15 drift-check rules (in `lock.json driftCheckRules`); any FAIL = fix
   before the next reset.
7. Record the new bundle content-hashes (identical sources → identical output).

## Snapshot recovery (server reset → 100% rebuild)

`snapshot/` holds byte-exact mirrors of the root build inputs. Full procedure
(restore → install → typecheck → build → verify) is in `snapshot/README.md`.

## File manifest

The authoritative manifest (path · bytes · sha256) lives in `lock.json`
under `files.entries`. `embeddedConfigs` carries byte-exact copies of
package.json / tsconfig.json / vite.config.js / index.html. Regenerate to
refresh fingerprints. `package-lock.json` is regenerated deterministically by
`npm install` (fingerprint in `lock.json packageLock`).

## Drift check

15 rules in `lock.json driftCheckRules` verify config consistency and
lockfile synchronization: root-vs-embedded byte equality (R01–R04),
root-vs-snapshot equality (R05–R08), lockfile integrity (R09), manifest
completeness (R10–R14), and content-hash output determinism (R15).

function hexToHsl(hex) {
  const s = hex.replace("#", "");
  const v = s.length === 3 ? s.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("") : s;
  const r = parseInt(v.slice(0, 2), 16) / 255 || 0;
  const g = parseInt(v.slice(2, 4), 16) / 255 || 0;
  const b = parseInt(v.slice(4, 6), 16) / 255 || 0;
  const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b);
  let h = 0;
  const l = (max + min) / 2;
  const d = max - min;
  const sat = d === 0 ? 0 : d / (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1));
  if (d !== 0) {
    if (max === r) h = (g - b) / d % 6;
    else if (max === g) h = (b - r) / d + 2;
    else
      h = (r - g) / d + 4;
    h *= 60;
    if (h < 0) h += 360;
  }
  return [h, sat * 100, l * 100];
}
const hsl = (h, s, l) => `hsl(${h.toFixed(1)} ${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, s)).toFixed(1)}% ${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, l)).toFixed(1)}%)`;

function applyAccent(accent) {
  const root = document.documentElement.style;
  const vars = ["--gold", "--gold-bright", "--gold-soft", "--gold-ink"];
  if (accent.toLowerCase() === "#c9a962") {
    vars.forEach((v) => root.removeProperty(v));
    return;
  }
  const [h, s, l] = hexToHsl(accent);
  root.setProperty("--gold", hsl(h, s, Math.min(72, l + 6)));
  root.setProperty("--gold-bright", hsl(h, s, Math.min(80, l + 14)));
  root.setProperty("--gold-soft", hsl(h, s * 0.7, 86));
  root.setProperty("--gold-ink", hsl(h, s * 0.7, 86));
}
function applyColors(colors) {
  const root = document.documentElement.style;
  ["--bg", "--bg-2", "--bg-3", "--bg-deep", "--surface", "--surface-2", "--ink", "--ink-2", "--ink-3", "--line", "--line-strong", "--on-gold", "--navy", "--royal", "--green", "--red", "--map-surface", "--map-grid", "--globe-dot", "--globe-line"].forEach((k) => {
    if (!(k in colors)) root.removeProperty(k);
  });
  Object.entries(colors).forEach(([k, v]) => {
    if (/^--[a-z0-9-]+$/i.test(k) && v) root.setProperty(k, v);
  });
}

  root.setProperty("--font-sans", `"${body}", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif`);
}

function seoPluginActive() {
  const w = window;
  return !!(w.yoast || w.rankMath || w.wpml || document.querySelector('meta[name="generator"][content*="Rank Math"]'));
}
function urlFor(l) {
  const base = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;
  return l === "en" ? base : `${base}?lang=${l}`;
}
function applySeoHead(l) {
  if (seoPluginActive()) return;
  try {
    const t = (k) => resolveCopy(l, k);
    document.documentElement.lang = l;
    document.documentElement.dir = "ltr";
    document.title = t("seo.title");
    const ensure = (sel, make) => {
      let el = document.head.querySelector(sel);
      if (!el) {
        el = make();
        document.head.appendChild(el);
      }
      return el;
    };
    ensure('meta[name="description"]', () => {
      const m = document.createElement("meta");
      m.name = "description";
      return m;
    }).content = t("seo.desc");
    const og = (p, c) => {
      ensure(`meta[property="og:${p}"]`, () => {
        const m = document.createElement("meta");
        m.setAttribute("property", `og:${p}`);
        return m;
      }).content = c;
    };
    og("title", t("seo.title"));
    og("description", t("seo.desc"));
    og("url", urlFor(l));
    og("locale", LANGS.find((x) => x.code === l)?.locale ?? "en_GB");
    let holder = document.getElementById("te-hreflang");
    if (!holder) {
      holder = document.createElement("span");
      holder.id = "te-hreflang";
      document.head.appendChild(holder);
    }
    holder.innerHTML = "";
    const codes = [...LANGS.map((x) => x.code), "x-default"];
    codes.forEach((code) => {
      const link = document.createElement("link");
      link.rel = code === "x-default" ? "alternate" : "alternate";
      link.setAttribute("hreflang", code);
      link.href = code === "x-default" ? urlFor("en") : urlFor(code);
      holder.appendChild(link);
    });
    const canon = ensure('link[rel="canonical"]', () => {
      const l2 = document.createElement("link");
      l2.rel = "canonical";
      return l2;
    });
    canon.href = urlFor(l);
  } catch {
  }
}
const LANG_KEY = "te-lang-v1";
function detectLang() {
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(LANG_KEY);
    if (stored && ["en", "fr", "es", "de"].includes(stored)) return stored;
  } catch {
  }
  const nav = (navigator.language || "en").slice(0, 2).toLowerCase();
  return ["fr", "es", "de"].includes(nav) ? nav : "en";
}

    },

    syncCopyOverrides(o);
  }, []);

const isPlain = (v) => !!v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v);
const mergeAny = (base, over) => {
  if (over === void 0 || over === null) return base;
  if (Array.isArray(base) && Array.isArray(over)) {
    return base.map((item, i) => mergeAny(item, over[i]));
  }
  if (isPlain(base) && isPlain(over)) {
    const out = { ...base };
    for (const k of Object.keys(over)) {
      if (k in base) out[k] = mergeAny(base[k], over[k]);
      else out[k] = over[k];
    }
    return out;
  }
  return over;
};
const mergeDeep = (base, over) => over === void 0 || over === null ? base : mergeAny(base, over);
const diffAny = (base, edited) => {
  if (edited === void 0) return void 0;
  if (Array.isArray(base) && Array.isArray(edited)) {
    const arr = base.map((item, i) => diffAny(item, edited[i]));
    return arr.some((x) => x !== void 0) ? arr : void 0;
  }
  if (isPlain(base) && isPlain(edited)) {
    const out = {};
    let any = false;
    for (const k of Object.keys(base)) {
      const d = diffAny(base[k], edited[k]);
      if (d !== void 0) {
        out[k] = d;
        any = true;
      }
    }
    return any ? out : void 0;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(base) === JSON.stringify(edited) ? void 0 : edited;
};
const diffDeep = (base, edited) => diffAny(base, edited);
export const localizeContent = (c, lang) => {
  if (lang === "en") return c;
  const over = c.translations?.[lang];
  return over ? mergeDeep(c, over) : c;
};
export const writeLocalized = (c, lang, edited) => {
  if (lang === "en") return { ...edited, translations: c.translations };
  const merged = mergeDeep(c, c.translations?.[lang]);
  const over = diffDeep(merged, edited) ?? {};
  return {
    ...c,
    translations: { ...c.translations ?? {}, [lang]: over }
  };
};

export function triggerDownload(blob, filename) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  a.style.display = "none";
  a.rel = "noopener";
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 400);
}

@@TE_FILE@@ path=src/prices.ts bytes=8480 nl=0 sha256=1e629e5646d09a4a31e204e98c094f30301b17993dac9f23bcadd555be4f9497
import __vite__cjsImport0_react from "/node_modules/.vite/deps/react.js?v=7e0c43c4"; const useEffect = __vite__cjsImport0_react["useEffect"]; const useRef = __vite__cjsImport0_react["useRef"]; const useState = __vite__cjsImport0_react["useState"];
export function useLivePrices(enabled = true, endpoint) {
  const [quotes, setQuotes] = useState({});
  const [isLive, setIsLive] = useState(false);
  const dead = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    dead.current = false;
    if (!enabled) return;
    const parseMap = (obj) => {
      const out = {};
      if (obj && typeof obj === "object" && !Array.isArray(obj)) {
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
          if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) out[k.toUpperCase()] = { px: v, unit: "", ts: Date.now() };
          else if (v && typeof v === "object" && typeof v.price === "number")
            out[k.toUpperCase()] = { px: v.price, unit: "", ts: Date.now() };
        }
      }
      return out;
    };
    const tick = async () => {
      try {
        if (endpoint) {
          const r2 = await fetch(endpoint, { cache: "no-store" });
          if (!r2.ok) return;
          const j2 = await r2.json();
          const m = parseMap(j2);
          if (Object.keys(m).length) {
            if (!dead.current) {
              setQuotes(m);
              setIsLive(true);
            }
            return;
          }
        }
        const r = await fetch("https://api.metals.live/v1/spot", { cache: "no-store" });
        if (!r.ok) return;
        const j = await r.json();
        const out = {};
        if (Array.isArray(j) && j.length) {
          const row = j[j.length - 1];
          if (typeof row.gold === "number") out.XAU = { px: row.gold, unit: "$/oz", ts: Date.now() };
          if (typeof row.silver === "number") out.XAG = { px: row.silver, unit: "$/oz", ts: Date.now() };
        }
        if (Object.keys(out).length && !dead.current) {
          setQuotes(out);
          setIsLive(true);
        }
      } catch {
      }
    };
    void tick();
    const id = window.setInterval(tick, 6e4);
    return () => {
      dead.current = true;
      clearInterval(id);
    };
  }, [enabled, endpoint]);
  return { quotes, isLive };
}

export const deriveFullLook = (accent) => {
  const s = accent.replace("#", "");
  const v = s.length === 3 ? s.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("") : s;
  const r = parseInt(v.slice(0, 2), 16) / 255 || 0;
  const g = parseInt(v.slice(2, 4), 16) / 255 || 0;
  const b = parseInt(v.slice(4, 6), 16) / 255 || 0;
  const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b);
  let h = 0;
  const l = (max + min) / 2;
  const d = max - min;
  const sat = d === 0 ? 0 : d / (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1));
  if (d !== 0) {
    if (max === r) h = (g - b) / d % 6;
    else if (max === g) h = (b - r) / d + 2;
    else
      h = (r - g) / d + 4;
    h = (h * 60 % 360 + 360) % 360;
  }
  const hsl = (hh2, ss2, ll) => `hsl(${hh2.toFixed(0)} ${(ss2 * 100).toFixed(0)}% ${ll.toFixed(1)}%)`;
  const hh = h;
  const ss = Math.max(0.14, sat * 0.8);
  return {
    "--bg": hsl(hh, ss * 0.9, 4.2),
    "--bg-2": hsl(hh, ss, 7),
    "--bg-3": hsl(hh, ss, 9),
    "--bg-deep": hsl(hh, ss * 0.9, 5),
    "--surface": hsl(hh, ss, 9.5),
    "--surface-2": hsl(hh, ss, 12),
    "--ink": hsl(hh, 0.2, 93),
    "--ink-2": hsl(hh, 0.18, 68),
    "--ink-3": hsl(hh, 0.2, 45),
    "--line": `hsla(${hh.toFixed(0)}, ${(ss * 100).toFixed(0)}%, 30%, 0.4)`,
    "--line-strong": hsl(hh, ss * 0.9, 27),
    "--navy": hsl(hh, ss, 7),
    "--royal": hsl(hh, ss, 17),
    "--globe-dot": hsl(hh, ss * 0.8, 30),
    "--globe-line": hsl(hh, ss * 0.8, 22),
    "--map-surface": hsl(hh, ss, 8),
    "--map-grid": `hsla(${hh.toFixed(0)}, ${(ss * 100).toFixed(0)}%, 32%, 0.5)`
  };
};

function loadJSON(key, fallback) {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (!raw) return fallback;
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

/* ---------- setup ---------- */
function te_setup() {
    add_theme_support( 'title-tag' );
    add_theme_support( 'custom-logo' ); /* image-only logo, no text fallback */
    add_theme_support( 'post-thumbnails' );
    add_theme_support( 'responsive-embeds' );

    register_nav_menus( array( 'primary' => __( 'Trade Hub Menu', 'triangle-edge' ) ) );
}
add_action( 'after_setup_theme', 'te_setup' );

/* ---------- assets (built by Vite) ---------- */
function te_assets() {
    $dir = TE_DIR . '/assets';
    $url = get_template_directory_uri() . '/assets';
    foreach ( glob( $dir . '/index-*.css' ) as $css ) {
        wp_enqueue_style( 'triangle-edge', $url . '/' . basename( $css ), array(), TE_VERSION );
    }
    foreach ( glob( $dir . '/index-*.js' ) as $js ) {
        wp_enqueue_script( 'triangle-edge', $url . '/' . basename( $js ), array(), TE_VERSION, true );
    }
}
add_action( 'wp_enqueue_scripts', 'te_assets' );

/* load the app as an ES module (Vite output) */
function te_script_loader_tag( $tag, $handle ) {
    if ( 'triangle-edge' === $handle ) {
        return str_replace( '<script ', '<script type="module" ', $tag );
    }
    return $tag;
}
add_filter( 'script_loader_tag', 'te_script_loader_tag', 10, 2 );

/* ---------- runtime flags + data for the app ---------- */
function te_runtime_config() {
    $is_admin_screen = is_admin() && isset( $_GET['page'] ) && 'te-studio' === $_GET['page'];
    $is_wp = true;
    $data = get_option( 'te_site_data' );
    echo '<script id="te-wp-flags">window.__TE_IS_WP__=1;' . ( $is_admin_screen ? 'window.__TE_ADMIN__=1;window.__TE_NONCE__="' . esc_js( wp_create_nonce( 'wp_rest' ) ) . '";' : '' ) . '<\/script>';
    if ( $data ) {
        echo '<script id="te-wp-data">window.__TE_DATA__=' . wp_json_encode( json_decode( $data, true ) ) . ';<\/script>';
    }
}
add_action( 'wp_head', 'te_runtime_config', 5 );
add_action( 'admin_head', 'te_runtime_config', 5 );

/* ---------- custom post types ---------- */
function te_cpts() {

        'te_commodity' => __( 'Commodities', 'triangle-edge' ),

            'supports'     => array( 'title', 'editor', 'thumbnail', 'excerpt', 'custom-fields' ),
        ) );

/* ---------- REST autosave (admin-only) ---------- */
function te_rest_routes() {
    register_rest_route( 'triangle-edge/v1', '/site', array(
        'methods'             => 'POST',
        'permission_callback' => function () { return current_user_can( 'manage_options' ); },
        'callback'            => function ( $req ) {
            $body = $req->get_json_params();
            update_option( 'te_site_data', wp_json_encode( array(
                'content'  => isset( $body['content'] ) ? $body['content'] : null,
                'settings' => isset( $body['settings'] ) ? $body['settings'] : null,
            ) ) );
            return array( 'ok' => true );
        },
    ) );
}
add_action( 'rest_api_init', 'te_rest_routes' );

/* ---------- multilingual SEO head (hreflang + canonical) ---------- */
function te_multilingual_head() {
    if ( defined( 'WPSEO_VERSION' ) || function_exists( 'rank_math' ) || defined( 'ICL_SITEPRESS_VERSION' ) || defined( 'POLYLANG_VERSION' ) ) return;
    $base = home_url( '/' );
    $cur  = isset( $_GET['lang'] ) ? sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['lang'] ) ) : 'en';
    if ( ! in_array( $cur, array( 'en', 'fr', 'es', 'de' ), true ) ) $cur = 'en';
    foreach ( array( 'en', 'fr', 'es', 'de' ) as $l ) {
        $href = ( 'en' === $l ) ? $base : add_query_arg( 'lang', $l, $base );
        echo '<link rel="alternate" hreflang="' . esc_attr( $l ) . '" href="' . esc_url( $href ) . '" />' . "\\n";
    }
    echo '<link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="' . esc_url( $base ) . '" />' . "\\n";
    echo '<link rel="canonical" href="' . esc_url( ( 'en' === $cur ) ? $base : add_query_arg( 'lang', $cur, $base ) ) . '" />' . "\\n";
}
add_action( 'wp_head', 'te_multilingual_head', 2 );

const poEscape = (s) => s.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/"/g, '\\"').replace(/\n/g, "\\n");
function toPo(lang) {
  const lines = [
    'msgid ""',
    'msgstr ""',
    '"Project-Id-Version: TriangleEdge 1.0.0\\n"',
    '"MIME-Version: 1.0\\n"',
    '"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\\n"',
    '"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\\n"',
    `"Language: ${lang ?? ""}\\n"`,
    ""
  ];
  const en = DICTS.en;
  for (const key of Object.keys(en)) {
    lines.push(`#: ${key}`);
    lines.push(`msgid "${poEscape(en[key])}"`);
    lines.push(`msgstr "${lang ? poEscape(DICTS[lang][key] ?? "") : ""}"`);
    lines.push("");
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}

    }

const sha256 = async (text) => {
  try {
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(text));
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

    let h = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) h = h * 31 + text.charCodeAt(i) | 0;
    return `fallback-${(h >>> 0).toString(16)}-${text.length}`;
  }

async function retryOnce(fn) {
  try {
    return await fn();
  } catch (e) {
    await sleep(350);
    return fn().then(
      (v) => v,
      () => Promise.reject(e)
    );
  }
}

async function loadViaFetch() {
  const files = {};
  const failed = [];
  await Promise.all(
    MANIFEST.map(async (p) => {
      try {
        const r = await fetch("/" + p, { cache: "no-store" });
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
        files[p] = await r.text();
      } catch {
        failed.push(p);
      }
    })
  );
  if (failed.length > MANIFEST.length * 0.25) {
    throw new Error(`raw-fetch fallback could not reach the workspace (${failed.length}/${MANIFEST.length} files unavailable)`);
  }
  return files;
}

    );
    cache = { ...PART_A, ...PART_B, ...PART_C, ...PART_D };
  } catch {

  }

}

const utf8 = (s) => new TextEncoder().encode(s);
async function sha256Hex(text) {
  try {
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", utf8(text));
    return [...new Uint8Array(buf)].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  } catch {
    return "sha256-unavailable";
  }
}
const SPLITTER = `#!/usr/bin/env node
/* Split a TriangleEdge rebuild archive back into the file tree.
   Usage:  node split-rebuild.mjs <rebuild.txt> [outDir]
   Works on the single archive OR the concatenation of all parts
   (cat part1 part2 part3 part4 > all.txt). */
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

const input = process.argv[2];
const outDir = process.argv[3] ?? ".";
if (!input) {
  console.error("Usage: node split-rebuild.mjs <rebuild.txt> [outDir]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const text = readFileSync(input, "utf8");
const lines = text.split("\\n");
let cur = null;
let buf = [];
let written = 0;
const flush = () => {
  if (!cur) return;
  let content = buf.join("\\n");
  if (cur.nl) content += "\\n";
  const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(content, "utf8");
  if (bytes !== cur.bytes) console.warn("byte mismatch (expected " + cur.bytes + ", got " + bytes + "): " + cur.path);
  const dest = join(outDir, cur.path);
  mkdirSync(dirname(dest), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(dest, content);
  written++;
  console.log("restored " + cur.path);
};
for (const line of lines) {
  const m = line.match(/^@@TE_FILE@@ path=(\\S+) bytes=(\\d+) nl=(0|1)/);
  if (m) {
    flush();
    cur = { path: m[1], bytes: Number(m[2]), nl: m[3] === "1" };
    buf = [];
    continue;
  }
  if (cur) {
    if (/^@@TE_(END|REBUILD|REBUILD_PART)@@/.test(line)) {
      flush();
      cur = null;
    } else buf.push(line);
  }
}
flush();
console.log(written + " files restored into " + outDir);
`;
const preamble = (meta) => [
  `# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────`,
  `# TriangleEdge — paste-optimized rebuild archive`,
  `# generated: ${meta.generated}`,
  `# files: ${meta.files} · bytes: ${meta.totalBytes} · body sha256: ${meta.bodySha256}`,
  `#`,
  `# REBUILD OPTIONS`,
  `# A) Automated — save this text as rebuild.txt, then:`,
  `#      node split-rebuild.mjs rebuild.txt .`,
  `#    (the splitter script is embedded below as its own block;`,
  `#     save it first: it is the @@TE_FILE@@ block "tools/split-rebuild.mjs")`,
  `# B) Chat paste — every source file begins at a line matching`,
  `#      @@TE_FILE@@ path=<relative path> bytes=<n> nl=<0|1>`,
  `#    and ends just before the next @@TE_FILE@@ or @@TE_END@@.`,
  `#    Paste the parts in order; no file is ever split across parts.`,
  `# C) Verify — per-file and whole-body SHA-256 fingerprints are in`,
  `#    the headers; lock.json drift rules R1–R15 still apply.`,
  `# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────`,

async function collect() {
  const { getFiles } = await import("/src/sources.ts?t=1787921121692");
  const FILES = await getFiles();
  const blocks = [];
  let body = "";
  for (const [path, content] of Object.entries(FILES)) {
    const nl = content.endsWith("\n") ? 1 : 0;
    const blocksBytes = utf8(content).length;
    const sha = await sha256Hex(content);
    blocks.push({ path, content, bytes: blocksBytes, nl, sha256: sha });
    body += `@@TE_FILE@@ path=${path} bytes=${blocksBytes} nl=${nl} sha256=${sha}
`;
    body += content;
    if (!nl) body += "\n";
  }
  const bodySha256 = await sha256Hex(body);
  return { blocks, body, bodySha256 };
}
export async function buildRebuildArchive() {
  const { body, bodySha256 } = await collect();
  const generated = (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toISOString();
  const toolBlock = `@@TE_FILE@@ path=tools/split-rebuild.mjs bytes=${utf8(SPLITTER).length} nl=1 sha256=${await sha256Hex(SPLITTER)}
` + SPLITTER;
  const files = body.split(/(?=^@@TE_FILE@@ )/m).filter((s) => s.length);
  const totalBytes = utf8(body).length;
  const meta = { files: files.length + 1, totalBytes: totalBytes + utf8(SPLITTER).length, bodySha256, generated };
  const singleBody = `@@TE_REBUILD@@ v=1 app=TriangleEdge files=${meta.files} bytes=${meta.totalBytes} sha256=${bodySha256} generated=${generated}
` + preamble(meta) + toolBlock + body + `@@TE_END@@ sha256=${bodySha256}
`;
  const PART_SIZE = 2e5;
  const chunks = [];
  let acc = toolBlock;
  for (const f of files) {
    if (acc.length + f.length > PART_SIZE && acc !== toolBlock) {
      chunks.push(acc);
      acc = "";
    }
    acc += f;
  }
  if (acc) chunks.push(acc);
  const parts = chunks.map((c, i) => ({
    name: `triangle-edge-rebuild.part${i + 1}of${chunks.length}.txt`,
    body: `@@TE_REBUILD_PART@@ v=1 part=${i + 1}/${chunks.length} app=TriangleEdge files=${meta.files} total_sha256=${bodySha256}
` + preamble(meta) + c + (i === chunks.length - 1 ? `@@TE_END@@ sha256=${bodySha256}
` : `# — continued in part ${i + 2}/${chunks.length} —
`)
  }));
  return {
    version: 1,
    generated,
    files: meta.files,
    totalBytes: meta.totalBytes,
    bodySha256,
    single: { name: "triangle-edge-rebuild.txt", body: singleBody },
    parts
  };
}
export async function downloadRebuildSingle() {
  const r = await buildRebuildArchive();
  triggerDownload(new Blob([r.single.body], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" }), r.single.name);
  return { name: r.single.name, body: r.single.body, parts: r.parts.length, bytes: r.totalBytes };
}
export async function downloadRebuildParts() {
  const r = await buildRebuildArchive();
  for (const p of r.parts) triggerDownload(new Blob([p.body], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" }), p.name);
  return { count: r.parts.length, names: r.parts.map((p) => p.name) };
}

# ⛴ The Freight Ballet — archived hero animation

**Status:** ARCHIVED — not part of the active build (removed from the hero on user request, kept for future use).
**Module:** physically dormant at `src/parade.ts` (nothing in the runtime imports it), and embedded byte-exact in every rebuild-paste file and source archive under `archive/freight-ballet/parade.ts`.

## What it is

A cinematic, sequential supply-chain crossing over the hero's cosmic particle network. One transport mode performs at a time, each entering on the previous one's trigger like a film cut:

| Order | Vehicle | Enters when | Direction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Convoy of 3 cargo ships (echelon) | scene opens | right → left |
| 2 | One big cargo aircraft | lead ship nears the far edge | left → right |
| 3 | Freight train (locomotive + 7 wagons) | aircraft reaches mid-screen | left → right |
| 4 | Fleet of 4 semi-trucks (staggered) | train reaches mid-screen | right → left |
| — | Scene resets & loops while the cosmic phase lasts, then hands off to the globe | fleet clears | — |

## Wake physics (the good part)

Each vehicle carries a **pure displacement field** — the identical mechanism to the hero's mouse wake:

1. **Radial clearance** — smoothstep falloff around the hull (110–185px by vehicle), particles glide out of the way; framerate-independent, so nothing shakes.
2. **Trailing flow** — the sea is gently dragged into the wake behind each vehicle, then reforms.
3. **Two propagating bow-wave ripples** per vehicle — Gaussian wavefronts travel outward and lift particles as the crest passes (the visible "wave").
4. **Lateral swirl** off the sides of ships and trains.

## Vehicle rendering

Holographic glass bodies: dark translucent hull gradients, gold rim-light double-strokes (soft bloom + sharp edge), hologram scanlines clipped inside every shape, luminous windows/engines/wheels via additive glow, headlight beams, blinking strobes, subtle flicker — vehicles speak the same visual language as the globe, not flat fills.

## How it was wired into `src/components/Hero.tsx`

Four blocks, all marked `TRANSPORT PARADE`:

1. **Import** (top): `import { createParade, drawParade, paradeWake, updateParade } from "../parade";`
2. **State** (after `const shocks`): `const parade = createParade();`
3. **Update** (in `drawFrame`, before the particle loop): build `paradeOpts` from `S.paradeShips/Planes/Trucks/Train/Speed/Wake`, then `const paradeAlpha = updateParade(parade, dt, pv, paradeOpts, W, H, cx, cy, time);`
4. **Wake force** (inside the particle loop, after click shockwaves): `const [wfx, wfy] = paradeWake(parade, x, y, dt, S.paradeWake ?? 1); x += wfx; y += wfy;`
5. **Draw** (after the signal rings, before hub markers): `if (paradeAlpha > 0.004) drawParade(ctx, parade, pv, time, C, paradeAlpha);`

Settings keys (still present, dormant, in `ThemeSettings`): `paradeShips`, `paradePlanes`, `paradeTrucks`, `paradeTrain`, `paradeSpeed`, `paradeWake`.

## Restoring it

1. Put `parade.ts` back at `src/parade.ts`.
2. Re-add the five integration blocks above to `src/components/Hero.tsx`.
3. Re-add the Neural-tab controls (four toggles + speed/wake sliders) to `src/components/AdminPanel.tsx`.
4. Re-add `"src/parade.ts"` to the `MANIFEST` in `src/sources.ts` and the `PART_C` map in `src/sources-c.ts`.

The module is 100% self-contained — no other file depends on it.

function parseColor(v) {
  const s = v.trim().toLowerCase();
  let m = s.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/);
  if (m) {
    let h = m[1];
    if (h.length === 3) h = h.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("");
    const n = parseInt(h, 16);
    return [n >> 16 & 255, n >> 8 & 255, n & 255];
  }
  m = s.match(/^rgba?\(\s*([\d.]+)[\s,]+([\d.]+)[\s,]+([\d.]+)/);
  if (m) return [+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]];

    const hh = +m[1] / 360, sat = +m[2] / 100, l = +m[3] / 100;
    const q = l < 0.5 ? l * (1 + sat) : l + sat - l * sat;
    const p = 2 * l - q;
    const f = (tt0) => {
      const tt = (tt0 % 1 + 1) % 1;
      if (tt < 1 / 6) return p + (q - p) * 6 * tt;
      if (tt < 1 / 2) return q;
      if (tt < 2 / 3) return p + (q - p) * (2 / 3 - tt) * 6;
      return p;
    };

  }
  return null;
}
